name: Synchronized registries with data for clients without the vanilla pack
note: Each bundle names its registry set: 17 registries for 1.21.8 and 11 for 1.21.4 sent by name to clients with the vanilla pack, the same entries as the official servers; clients without the pack get a documented minimal set with data
deviations: 1.21.8 dialogs and game-test registries are not sent
clients without the vanilla pack get only dimension types, plains and the chat type with data
enchantments are sent only with the official jar's data pack
